crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and…
At the end of seven days, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

translations.web: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
translations.bsb: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
translations.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
translations.asv: Now the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
